_comment: Ko-fi members at the Patron ($100/month) or Featured Sponsor ($300/month) tier, added by hand (Ko-fi can't be read automatically). Key = "kofi-" + a short name. amount = their monthly tier in dollars. url (optional) = the link for their name. until (optional, YYYY-MM-DD) = when to stop listing them - set it, or remove them, when they cancel. A Featured Sponsor also needs an entry with the same key in featured-approved.json. Example: "kofi-example": {"name": "Example Exchange", "url": "https://example.com", "amount": 300}
